_note: Voice lines. Each sin speaks only about itself and only in its own register. No line ever explains a mechanic - the boss card already does that. Lines are picked without replacement until the pool exhausts, so a player never hears the same taunt twice in one encounter.

first_ever: Sit. You have not been here before. You will be again.
run_start: Again. Sit. You know the terms.
The wheel does not remember you. I do.
Back so soon. The ledger is where you left it.
run_start_late: Run forty. I have stopped counting aloud.
You are further in than when you started. That is usual.
Most stop by now. You are not most.
bank: You leave with something. That is rarer than you think.
The ledger moves. Barely. But it moves.
bust: The house keeps what the house is owed.
It was never yours to carry out.
bust_deep: You had it. You wanted more of it.
One more spin. Always one more spin.

arrival: Look how well you were doing.
taunt: You had begun to think this was skill.
Say it. Say you deserved the last one.
Smaller now, aren't they.
humility_progress: Two. Do not look at me.
expired: I have seen enough of you.
player_fled: Leaving? While ahead? That is almost humble.

arrival: A third. That is all. A third of everything.
taunt: You have not stopped. I did not expect you to.
It is all still here. In the pile. Behind me.
A third of a great deal is a great deal.
defeated: Take it. You will bring it back.
player_fled: You left the pile. Nobody leaves the pile.

arrival: I have opened the wheel wider for you.
taunt: More room now. Do you feel it.
Spin. I have made it interesting.
You are still here. Good.
expired: I close it again. Not far.

arrival: Whatever you love most, I have already copied.
taunt: You keep going back to it. I noticed.
It is thinner now, isn't it.
I only wanted what you had.
defeated: Keep it. It was never as good as it looked.
expired: I have what I came for.
player_fled: Take it with you. I have a copy.

arrival: Nothing is where you left it.
taunt: You were counting. Start again.
There. And there. And not there.
You had a system. Past tense.
defeated: Put it back how you found it, then.
expired: I leave it as I found it. Roughly.
player_fled: You never learned the board anyway.

arrival: You have carried that long enough. Set it down.
taunt: A little more. You will not miss it.
Heavier than when you came in, isn't it.
Still holding on. Admirable. Foolish.
defeated: I am not finished. I am never finished.
player_fled: You left with a full purse. I will remember.

arrival: There is no hurry. There never was.
taunt: Take your time. I have all of it.
You stopped. I felt you stop.
Again. Slower.
expired: You may proceed at your own pace.
player_fled: You waited too long to leave. As always.

reactive._note: Fired by behaviour, not by encounter state. This is what makes the wheel feel like it is watching.

banked_instantly_thrice.speaker: croupier
banked_instantly_thrice.line: You bank the moment I look away. I do not blame you.

never_banked_this_run.speaker: greed
never_banked_this_run.line: You have not banked once. I like you.

survived_all_seven.speaker: croupier
survived_all_seven.line: All seven, in one sitting. The ledger has a page for that.

bust_at_high_purse.speaker: croupier
bust_at_high_purse.line: You had enough. You wanted the number to be rounder.

fragments._note: Unlocked by defeating a sin N times. Delivered on the ledger screen, never mid-run. Each answers a little of why the player is at the wheel at all - and never all of it.
fragments.pride_3: You signed it yourself. Nobody held your hand.
fragments.greed_3: The sum was small. That was the trick of it. The sum is always small.
fragments.wrath_3: You broke something you have not named yet.
fragments.envy_3: It was somebody else's life. You wanted the shape of it.
fragments.lust_3: You had a plan. You have had several.
fragments.gluttony_3: You were not hungry. That was never the reason.
fragments.sloth_3: You could have left in the first week.
fragments.all_7: The Croupier turns the wheel. He does not spin it. You have always spun it.
